calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY ALL),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net, r.refunds_net, s.sales_net - r.refunds_net AS net_sales
FROM web_sales s JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2
